description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_HTMLDefinition class, which manages the structure and configuration of allowed HTML elements, attributes, and transformations within the HTML Purifier library. It includes methods for customizing elements and attributes, processing modules, and parsing TinyMCE allowed lists.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLDefinition
classes.description: Manages the structure, allowed elements, attributes, and transformations for HTML purification, including methods for customization and module processing.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Adds a custom attribute to an existing HTML element within the definition.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds a custom element to the HTML definition with specified parameters.

methods.name: addBlankElement
methods.description: Adds a blank (self-closing) element to the HTML definition.

methods.name: getAnonymousModule
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an anonymous module for advanced customization.

methods.name: doSetup
methods.description: Performs initial setup and module processing based on configuration.

methods.name: processModules
methods.description: Processes and integrates modules into the HTML definition.

methods.name: setupConfigStuff
methods.description: Configures allowed, forbidden elements and attributes, and injectors based on settings.

methods.name: parseTinyMCEAllowedList
methods.description: Parses a TinyMCE-style list of allowed elements and attributes into structured arrays.
